errors.text_span: Importe beginnen bei etwa 210 Milliarden im Jahr 2020
errors.evidence: Description mentions imports start at 210 billion, but reference states start at 200 billion.

errors.text_span: Exporte beginnen bei etwa 130 Milliarden Anfang 2020
errors.evidence: Description mentions exports start at 130 billion, whereas the reference states they start at 100 billion.

errors.text_span: rechtes Y-Achse ... linearer Skala von -200 bis 0 Milliarden
errors.evidence: Reference states that the right axis scale is from -200 to 400 billion, not 0.

errors.text_span: dunkelblaue Linie ... lila Linie ... blaue Balken
errors.evidence: Reference indicates the blue line corresponds to imports, the red line to exports, and states nothing about a purple line or that the bars are blue.
The description does not mention tick intervals for the axes or that the left y-axis includes imports in addition to exports.
The description fails to mention that there are small bars starting from the height of 0 on the right scale that grow longer over time.
